items.title: 68002_Benny Waters oral history interview
items.q: Interviewer mentions Johnny Dunn as someone 'you might have heard of', and the interviewee does not provide any personal anecdote or confirmation of meeting/collaborating.

ctx.x: Now - by the way, speaking, you brought up trumpet - you know, I mentioned Bechet and Armstrong, you know, there were other people around who you might have heard of a couple of years later like Dunn, Johnny Dunn and Johnny Dunn and Joe Smith -
